thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-10 confirms yesterday's negative macro thread: 'Stocks fall on Wall Street as oil prices jump back above $100 a barrel after Iran war escalates,' with the IEA also flagging a Strait of Hormuz blockade pushing global coal use higher. This continues to argue for caution, not for adding to the core sleeve. It's also not a reason to sell a small, long-held diversified ETF position -- broad selling pressure from oil/geopolitics doesn't change the multi-year investment case for a core VTI holding. The rest of the pack is single-name stock-mover commentary and routine politician PTR filings. Existing VTI position (~22.5 of ~107.5 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than reacting to macro headline risk, consistent with capital preservation.
